tokens.page: min-height: 100vh; background-color: #ffffff; color: #14122b; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.65; font-size: 1.0625rem;
tokens.nav: position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; background-color: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7e6f0;
tokens.nav-brand: font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #14122b; text-decoration: none;
tokens.hero: position: relative; overflow: hidden; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #eceeff 0%, #ffffff 100%); padding: 4.5rem 1.5rem 4rem;
tokens.blob-indigo: position: absolute; top: -9rem; right: -7rem; width: 30rem; height: 30rem; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #c9ccff 0%, rgba(201, 204, 255, 0) 70%);
tokens.blob-pink: position: absolute; bottom: 12rem; left: -9rem; width: 24rem; height: 24rem; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 60% 40%, #ffd9e8 0%, rgba(255, 217, 232, 0) 70%);
tokens.display-title: font-size: clamp(4.5rem, 20vw, 10rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.06em; line-height: 0.9; margin: 0 0 1rem; color: #14122b;
tokens.subtitle: font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.2; color: #4f46e5; margin: 0 0 3rem;
tokens.hero-image: display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -20px rgba(20, 18, 43, 0.35);
tokens.lead: font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 62rem; text-wrap: balance; margin: 3rem 0 0;
tokens.banner-title: max-width: 72rem; margin: 0 auto; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 5vw, 3rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.1;
tokens.section-row: display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2rem 4rem; max-width: 72rem; margin: 0 auto;
tokens.card-raised: flex: 1 1 20rem; border-top: 4px solid #4f46e5; padding: 2rem; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -24px rgba(20, 18, 43, 0.25);
tokens.page-title: font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 8vw, 3.25rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.1; margin: 0 0 2.5rem;
tokens.footer-inner: max-width: 72rem; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem;
tokens.title-bar: font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.1; margin-top: 0; margin-left: 0; margin-right: 0; padding-left: 1rem; border-left: 4px solid #4f46e5; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere;
